source: Manual screenshots + Copy log reports from 2026-11-25 local Reskinner testing
goal: Original 1:1 playable/reskinnable mirrors. Do not certify menu/loading screen as gameplay.
scope: Six newly reported manual failures; gameplay count baseline 3/69; prior three green remain excluded from new testing.
warning: status=blocked means not yet demonstrably playable; hypotheses are not validated fixes. Missing /extracted images may originate from Reskinner asset gallery.

issues.title: Hangman

hypotheses: Unexpected iframe navigation to about:blank or host-dependent boot script
Missing or blocked entry dependency not captured by onload
nextActions: Inspect original local index.html and navigation URLs
Capture document/console/network events at document-start in Chrome CDP
